deck.title: The Mental Models Daily Core Deck
deck.line: 60 mental models to elevate your daily decision making
deck.subtitle: 60 mental models to elevate your daily decision making, with true stories, questions to ask and a guide

listing.short: Sixty of the most useful mental models, one to a card. Draw one in the morning and use it all day.
description: Mental models are the shortcuts clear thinkers use to see what is really going on. The Core Deck gathers 60 of the most useful, from Inversion and Second-Order Thinking to Hanlon’s Razor and the Pareto Principle, and puts each one on a card you can hold.

The front is for remembering: a pencil drawing, the model’s name and the idea in one line. The back is for using it: what it means, when to reach for it, a true story in which it mattered, and a question to ask yourself.

The cards come in eight colours, one for each situation you face, from making a decision to fixing problems. Facing something hard? The guide card points you to the colour that helps, and the decision spread gives you three cards to think it through.
ways: 60 model cards in eight colours, one for each situation: decisions, risk, people, work, strategy, evidence, your own mind and fixing problems
On the front: a pencil drawing, the model’s name and the idea in one line
On the back: what it means, when to reach for it, a true story and a question to ask yourself
Six house cards: a guide to find the right card for your situation, five ways to use the deck (from a daily draw to a table game for two to six people) and a two-card index
Tarot size, 70 × 121 mm (2.75 × 4.75 in), on heavy card stock, in a tuck box
listing.in_the_box: 66 cards: 60 model cards, a title card, a guide, ways to use the deck, two index cards and a closing card; one tuck box
listing.for_whom: For anyone who makes decisions for a living or for themselves: founders, managers, consultants, students and curious minds. A thoughtful gift for the person who has every book.
specs: 300–350 gsm card with a black core, matte finish
listing.closing: From the creators of the Mental Models Daily podcast. For learning and reflection, not professional advice.

deck.meta_description: 60 mental models on beautifully drawn cards, each with a true story and a question to ask. Draw one a day and decide better. From Mental Models Daily.

workbook.title: The Mental Models Daily Workbook
workbook.features: Exercises · Worksheets · A month of practice
description: Better decisions, one model at a time.

Mental models are the shortcuts clear thinkers use to see what is really going on. This workbook takes 60 of the most useful, from Second-Order Thinking and Inversion to Hanlon’s Razor and Bayes’ Theorem, and turns each one into a tool you can use on your own life today.

Each model gets two pages. On the left you learn it: the idea in one line, a plain explanation, the moments to reach for it and a true story where it mattered. On the right you practise it: one question to ask, three short exercises to write out and a sentence to finish before you move on.
inside: A situation finder: start from what is happening to you and turn to the model that helps
60 two-page spreads drawn from science, numbers, the mind, people and society, and systems
True stories, from the Brooklyn Bridge to the Zillow crash
Worksheets for big decisions, pre-mortems and stubborn problems
A glossary of all 60 models, grouped by subject

almanac.title: The Mental Models Daily Almanac
almanac.features: True stories · Drawings · A year of reading
description: 365 mental models for clearer thinking, with 730 true stories: one model for every day of the year.

Mental models are the shortcuts clear thinkers use to cut through noise and decide well. This almanac gathers 365 of them, one for every day of the year, from Inversion and Second-Order Thinking to Hanlon’s Razor, Bayes’ Theorem and the Lindy Effect, and gives each one a single, illustrated page in a large, easy-to-read format.

Each page explains the idea in plain words, tells a true story from history and one from business, offers three small ways to use it this week, warns where it misleads, and ends with a question to carry with you.
inside: 365 mental models, one large page each, with a pencil drawing
Eight parts built around the situations you face: decisions, risk, people, work, strategy, evidence, your own mind and fixing problems
730 true stories, from the Royal Navy’s lemons to the Fastly outage
Two overviews at the front, every model by situation and by field, and an A to Z at the back
An index of all 730 stories, so you can find the person, company or event you remember
Toolkits for ten kinds of work, from investor and founder to doctor and student
